trigger.match: ^If you want to keep this item, don't forget to 'preserve' it\.$
^(?<junk>\([\s0-9][0-9]\))?\s+?(?<junk2>\([A-Z]\))?\s(?<typeofitem>(a solid helm|a pair of gloves|a set of sleeves|a pair of leggings|a pair of boots|a protective cloak)) skinned from .*$
^You carve the corpse into a complete mess! You need more practice\.$
^You didn't find a corpse suitable for skinning\.$

muclient.script:
require "serialize" require "wait" require "commas" require "gmcphelper"
skinnerColor = "khaki" skinnerWait = 3 skinnerSmote = true skinnerPlayer = gmcp("char.base.name") skinnerDropWait = 1
local dropGeneration = 0
numcorpse = 0 skinsProcessed = 0 skinsSuccessful = 0 blootBatchCount = 0 blootBatchTypes = {} skinningBatchFinished = false
-- Bloot qualities that should be treated as normal/discarded skins. -- This table can be changed with: -- skinner nokeep <quality> -- -- The selection is persisted in the MUSHclient plugin state. local discardBlootTypes = {}
local function normalizeNoKeepName(value) value = tostring(value or "")
-- Trim whitespace. value = value:gsub("^%s+", "") value = value:gsub("%s+$", "")
if value == "" then return "" end
-- Store consistently as Polished, Enhanced, Godly, etc. value = string.lower(value)
return value:sub(1, 1):upper() .. value:sub(2) end
local function saveNoKeepTypes() SetVariable( "ks_nokeeptypes", serialize.save_simple(discardBlootTypes) )
SaveState() end
local function loadNoKeepTypes(defaultTypes) local saved = GetVariable("ks_nokeeptypes")
if saved ~= nil and saved ~= "" then local chunk = loadstring("return " .. saved)
if chunk then local ok, restored = pcall(chunk)
if ok and type(restored) == "table" then discardBlootTypes = restored return end end end
-- No saved setting yet, so use this plugin's defaults. discardBlootTypes = defaultTypes or {}
saveNoKeepTypes() end
loadNoKeepTypes({})
-- All supported skin types. "rotate" advances once per skin attempt. local rotatingSkinTypes = { "cloak", "helm", "leggings", "sleeves", "gloves", "boots" }
local rotateSkinIndex = tonumber(GetVariable("ks_rotateindex")) or 1
if rotateSkinIndex < 1 or rotateSkinIndex > #rotatingSkinTypes then rotateSkinIndex = 1 SetVariable("ks_rotateindex", tostring(rotateSkinIndex)) end
local function getNextSkinType() if skintype ~= "rotate" then return skintype end
local currentType = rotatingSkinTypes[rotateSkinIndex]
rotateSkinIndex = rotateSkinIndex + 1 if rotateSkinIndex > #rotatingSkinTypes then rotateSkinIndex = 1 end
SetVariable("ks_rotateindex", tostring(rotateSkinIndex)) return currentType end
local tag = "@D[@GSkinner Stats@D] :@w"
-- Default Enabled = On if (GetVariable("ks_enabled") ~= nil) then enabled = GetVariable("ks_enabled") else SetVariable("ks_enabled", "yes") enabled = "yes" end
-- Default Preserve = "no" if (GetVariable("ks_preserve") ~= nil) then preserve = GetVariable("ks_preserve") else SetVariable("ks_preserve", "bloot") preserve = "bloot" end
-- Default throwAway = "no" if (GetVariable("ks_throwaway") ~= nil) then throwAway = GetVariable("ks_throwaway") else SetVariable("ks_throwaway", "no") throwAway = "no" end
-- Default autobagger = "no" if (GetVariable("ks_autobag") ~= nil) then autobagger = GetVariable("ks_autobag") else SetVariable("ks_autobag", "no") autobagger = "no" end
-- Default autobagger = "no" if (GetVariable("ks_bag") ~= nil) then thebag = GetVariable("ks_bag") else SetVariable("ks_bag", "no") thebag = "" end
-- Default Skin Type = "Cloak" if (GetVariable("ks_skintype") ~= nil) then -- skitype = GetVariable("ks_skintype") skintype = GetVariable("ks_skintype") else SetVariable("ks_skintype", "cloak") skintype = "cloak" end
function toggleNoKeep(name, line, args) local quality = normalizeNoKeepName(args.type)
if quality == "" then ColourNote( "red", "", "[Skinner]: Usage: skinner nokeep <quality>" ) return end
if discardBlootTypes[quality] then -- Already excluded, so remove it. discardBlootTypes[quality] = nil
ColourTell("khaki", "", "[Skinner] ") ColourTell("white", "", ":: No-Keep :: ") ColourTell("white", "", quality) ColourNote("lime", "", " removed")
else -- Not excluded, so add it. discardBlootTypes[quality] = true
ColourTell("khaki", "", "[Skinner] ") ColourTell("white", "", ":: No-Keep :: ") ColourTell("white", "", quality) ColourNote("red", "", " added") end
saveNoKeepTypes() end
-- Persistent skinning statistics -- -- We save these stats in TWO places: -- 1) MUSHclient plugin state variable "ks_data" -- 2) A separate backup file named "skinner_stats_backup.dat" -- -- The backup file uses the MUSHclient state directory when possible. Because -- its filename does not depend on the plugin ID, it can recover the report -- data even if the plugin XML is reinstalled with a different ID/version. local data = { totalskins = 0, lastBonus = 0, loot = {} }
local function normalizeSkinnerData() if type(data) ~= "table" then data = {} end
data.totalskins = tonumber(data.totalskins) or 0 data.lastBonus = tonumber(data.lastBonus)
if data.lastBonus == nil then data.lastBonus = data.totalskins end
if type(data.loot) ~= "table" then data.loot = {} end
for quality, count in pairs(data.loot) do data.loot[quality] = tonumber(count) or 0 end end
local function deserializeSkinnerData(serialized) if serialized == nil or serialized == "" then return nil end
local chunk, compileError = loadstring("return " .. serialized)
if not chunk then return nil, compileError end
local ok, result = pcall(chunk)
if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then return nil, result end
return result end
local function getSkinnerBackupFile() -- MUSHclient documentation identifies GetInfo(85) as the plugin -- state directory. Prefer it because it is independent of the XML file. local directory = GetInfo(85)
-- Fall back to the directory containing this plugin if necessary. if directory == nil or directory == "" then directory = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 20) end
if directory == nil or directory == "" then return nil end
local lastChar = directory:sub(-1)
if lastChar ~= "\\" and lastChar ~= "/" then local separator = package.config:sub(1, 1) directory = directory .. separator end
return directory .. "skinner_stats_backup.dat" end
local function writeSkinnerBackup() normalizeSkinnerData()
local backupFile = getSkinnerBackupFile()
if backupFile == nil then return false, "Could not determine backup directory." end
local file, openError = io.open(backupFile, "w")
if not file then return false, openError end
file:write(serialize.save_simple(data)) file:close()
return true end
local function readSkinnerBackup() local backupFile = getSkinnerBackupFile()
if backupFile == nil then return nil, "Could not determine backup directory." end
local file = io.open(backupFile, "r")
if not file then return nil, "Backup file does not exist." end
local serialized = file:read("*a") file:close()
return deserializeSkinnerData(serialized) end
local function saveSkinnerData(saveStateNow) normalizeSkinnerData()
-- Save to the normal MUSHclient plugin-state variable. SetVariable("ks_data", serialize.save_simple(data))
-- Also maintain an independent backup copy. writeSkinnerBackup()
-- Force the state file to disk immediately unless explicitly suppressed. if saveStateNow ~= false then SaveState() end end
local function loadSkinnerData() -- First choice: the normal MUSHclient state variable. local stateData = deserializeSkinnerData(GetVariable("ks_data"))
if stateData then data = stateData normalizeSkinnerData() return "state" end
-- Second choice: our independent backup file. local backupData = readSkinnerBackup()
if backupData then data = backupData normalizeSkinnerData()
-- Put the restored backup back into normal plugin state. SetVariable("ks_data", serialize.save_simple(data))
return "backup" end
data = { totalskins = 0, lastBonus = 0, loot = {} }
return "new" end
-- On plugin install ... function OnPluginInstall(msg, id, name, text) local loadSource = loadSkinnerData()
ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Plugin installed") ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Defaulted to " .. enabled) ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Defaulted to type of " .. skintype) ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Defaulted to auto-preserve " .. preserve) ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Defaulted to auto-drop " .. throwAway) ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Defaulted to auto-bag " .. autobagger) ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Defaulted to storage bag " .. thebag)
if loadSource == "backup" then ColourNote( "lime", "", "[Skinner]: Skinning statistics restored from backup." ) elseif loadSource == "state" then ColourNote( skinnerColor, "", "[Skinner]: Existing skinning statistics loaded." ) else ColourNote( skinnerColor, "", "[Skinner]: No previous statistics found; starting fresh." ) end
-- Ensure both persistent copies exist immediately. saveSkinnerData() end
function OnPluginSaveState() -- Do NOT call SaveState() from inside this callback. -- MUSHclient is already in the process of saving the state file. normalizeSkinnerData() SetVariable("ks_data", serialize.save_simple(data)) writeSkinnerBackup() end
function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, text) if (id == '3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264') then if (text == "char.status") then res, gmcparg = CallPlugin("3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264","gmcpval","char.status") luastmt = "gmcpdata = " .. gmcparg --- Convert the serialized string back into a lua table. assert (loadstring (luastmt or "")) ()
if gmcpdata.state == "8" then inCombat = true numcorpse = 0 else if inCombat then if enabled == "yes" then lookSend() end end inCombat = false end end end end
function lookSend(name, line, args) wait.make (function() SendNoEcho("echo {kelskin}") SendNoEcho("look") SendNoEcho("echo {/kelskin}") wait.time(skinnerWait) end) end
function startCapture(name, line, args) EnableTriggerGroup("skinnergroup", true)
numcorpse = 0 skinsProcessed = 0 skinsSuccessful = 0 blootBatchCount = 0 blootBatchTypes = {} skinningBatchFinished = false end
-- End the capture of the config output function endCapture(name, line, args) EnableTriggerGroup("skinnergroup", false)
if numcorpse <= 0 then return end
skinMobs() end
-- Start the capture of the inv output function startInvCapture(name, line, args) EnableTriggerGroup("skinnerinv", true) end
-- End the capture of the inv output function endInvCapture(name, line, args) EnableTriggerGroup("skinnerinv", false) end
-- Add corpses that you find so we can skin them function addCorpse(name, line, args) local toadd = 1
if args.number and args.number ~= "" then local countText = string.sub(args.number, 2, -2) countText = string.gsub(countText, "%s+", "") toadd = tonumber(countText) or 1 end
numcorpse = numcorpse + toadd end
-- Show the help! function ShowHelp(name, line, args)
Note("")
ColourNote( "cyan", "", "-------------------- Skinner Help --------------------" )
Note("")
-- MAIN COMMANDS ColourNote("yellow", "", "GENERAL")
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner enable") ColourNote("silver", "", " Enable automatic skinning")
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner disable") ColourNote("silver", "", " Disable automatic skinning")
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner status") ColourNote("silver", "", " Show current Skinner settings")
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner test") ColourNote("silver", "", " Manually scan the room for corpses")
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner help") ColourNote("silver", "", " Show this help")
Note("")
-- SKIN SETTINGS ColourNote("yellow", "", "SKINNING")
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner type <type>") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Set skin type: boots, leggings, sleeves, cloak, gloves, helm, rotate" )
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner type rotate") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Rotate through every skin type, one corpse at a time" )
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner auto yes") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Auto-preserve all created skins" )
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner auto bloot") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Preserve only qualifying bloot" )
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner auto no") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Disable automatic preserving" )
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner drop yes|no") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Enable/disable dropping unwanted skins" )
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner bag yes|no") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Enable/disable automatic bloot bagging" )
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner bag <bag>") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Set storage bag keyword or item ID" ) ColourTell("white", "", " skinner nokeep <quality>") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Toggle a bloot quality between keep and discard" )
ColourTell("white", "", " Example: skinner nokeep polished") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Add/remove Polished from the discard list" )
Note("")
-- REPORTING ColourNote("yellow", "", "REPORTING")
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner report <channel>") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Send lifetime Skinner statistics to a channel" )
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner report note") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Display the report locally in MUSHclient" )
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner backup") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Immediately back up lifetime report data" )
ColourTell("white", "", " skinner restore") ColourNote( "silver", "", " Restore lifetime report data from backup" )
Note("")
ColourNote( "cyan", "", "------------------------------------------------------" )
Note("") end
-- Do the skinning of the mobs function skinMobs() ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Skinning Mobs")
for i = 1, numcorpse do local currentSkinType = getNextSkinType()
SendNoEcho("skin " .. currentSkinType) data.totalskins = data.totalskins + 1
if preserve == "yes" then ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Auto-preserving skin...") SendNoEcho("preserve " .. currentSkinType) end end
if skinnerSmote then --Send("echo @W>> @x204T@x211his@x217 @x218room @x224h@x255as@x231 be@x218e@x204n @x211ski@x217n@x218ned by @C" .. skinnerPlayer .. ".@w") end end
--Finished skinning local function checkSkinningFinished() if skinningBatchFinished then return end
if skinsProcessed < numcorpse then return end
skinningBatchFinished = true
-- Count only bloot qualities that are NOT on the discard list. local keptBlootCount = 0
for quality, count in pairs(blootBatchTypes) do if not discardBlootTypes[quality] then keptBlootCount = keptBlootCount + count end end
-- Show one completion message. -- Discarded qualities if keptBlootCount > 0 then SendNoEcho( "echo @M----> @WSKINNING @MCOMPLETE@W! @Y" .. skinsSuccessful .. "@W/@Y" .. numcorpse .. "@W corpse" .. (numcorpse == 1 and "" or "s") .. " successfully skinned. @Y" .. keptBlootCount .. "@W potential bloot item" .. (keptBlootCount == 1 and "" or "s") .. " crafted. @M<----@w" ) else SendNoEcho( "echo @R--> @WSKINNING @GCOMPLETE@W! @Y" .. skinsSuccessful .. "@W/@Y" .. numcorpse .. "@W corpse" .. (numcorpse == 1 and "" or "s") .. " skinned with @Y0@W potential bloot(s). @R<--@w" ) end
wait.make(function()
-- Keep and preserve bloot, except hard-coded discard qualities. for quality, count in pairs(blootBatchTypes) do if not discardBlootTypes[quality] then local keyword = string.lower(quality)
SendNoEcho( "keep all.'" .. keyword .. " skinned'" )
if preserve == "bloot" or preserve == "yes" then for itemNumber = 1, count do SendNoEcho( "preserve " .. itemNumber .. "." .. keyword ) end end end end
-- Allow keep/preserve commands to finish wait.time(skinnerDropWait)
-- Move this batch's bloot into the configured bag if autobagger == "yes" and keptBlootCount > 0 then if thebag == nil or thebag == "" then ColourNote( skinnerColor, "", "[Skinner]: You need to set your bag!" ) else for quality in pairs(blootBatchTypes) do if not discardBlootTypes[quality] then SendNoEcho( "put all.'" .. string.lower(quality) .. " skinned' " .. thebag ) end end
-- Give bag commands time to process wait.time(1) end end
-- Drop all remaining normal skins if throwAway == "yes" and skinsSuccessful > 0 then SendNoEcho("drop all.skinned") end
-- Persist lifetime report data before leaving the room. saveSkinnerData()
end) end
-- Called by the existing successful-skin trigger function skinningDone() skinsProcessed = skinsProcessed + 1 skinsSuccessful = skinsSuccessful + 1
checkSkinningFinished() end
-- Called by the new failed-skin trigger function skinningFailed() skinsProcessed = skinsProcessed + 1
checkSkinningFinished() end
-- Set the type of skin function changeType(name, line, args) skintype = string.lower(args.type)
if skintype == "rotate" then rotateSkinIndex = 1 SetVariable("ks_rotateindex", tostring(rotateSkinIndex))
ColourNote( skinnerColor, "", "[Skinner]: Type changed to rotate (cloak, helm, leggings, sleeves, gloves, boots)" ) else ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Type changed to " .. skintype) end
SetVariable("ks_skintype", skintype) end
-- Set auto-preserve function autoPreserve(name,line,args) preserve = string.lower(args.type) ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Auto-Preserve changed to " .. preserve) SetVariable("ks_preserve",preserve) end
-- Set auto-drop function autoDrop(name,line,args) throwAway = string.lower(args.type) ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Auto-Drop changed to " .. throwAway) SetVariable("ks_throwaway",throwAway) end
-- Set auto-bag function autoBag(name,line,args) autobagger = string.lower(args.type) ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Auto-Bag changed to " .. autobagger) SetVariable("ks_autobag",autobagger) end
-- Set bagname function setBag(name,line,args) thebag = string.lower(args.type) ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Storage Bag changed to " .. thebag) SetVariable("ks_bag", thebag) end
-- Turn skinner on function enableSkinner() enabled = "yes" ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Skinner enabled") SetVariable("ks_enabled",enabled) end
-- Turn skinner off function disableSkinner() enabled = "no" ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Skinner disabled") SetVariable("ks_enabled",enabled) end
local function getNoKeepList() local types = {}
for quality in pairs(discardBlootTypes) do table.insert(types, quality) end
table.sort(types)
if #types == 0 then return "None" end
return table.concat(types, ", ") end
-- Show skinner status function showStatus()
local function statusValue(value) value = tostring(value or "Not Set")
if string.lower(value) == "yes" then return "lime", "YES" elseif string.lower(value) == "no" then return "red", "NO" else return "white", value end end
local function statusLine(label, value) local color, displayValue = statusValue(value)
ColourTell( "silver", "", string.format(" %-18s : ", label) )
ColourNote( color, "", displayValue ) end
Note("")
ColourNote( "cyan", "", "------------------- Skinner Status -------------------" )
Note("")
ColourNote("yellow", "", "SKINNING")
statusLine("Enabled", enabled) if skintype == "rotate" then statusLine( "Skin Type", "rotate (next: " .. rotatingSkinTypes[rotateSkinIndex] .. ")" ) else statusLine("Skin Type", skintype) end statusLine("Auto-Preserve", preserve) statusLine("Auto-Drop", throwAway) statusLine("Auto-Bag", autobagger) statusLine("Storage Bag", thebag) statusLine("No-Keep Bloot", getNoKeepList())
Note("")
ColourNote( "cyan", "", "------------------------------------------------------" )
Note("") end
-- We got bloot! Let's do things! function addBloot(name, line, args) local iType = ""
if args.bloot == nil or args.bloot == "" then iType = "Normal" else iType = args.bloot end
-- Strip parentheses, including the doubled Godly format. iType = string.gsub(iType, "%(", "") iType = string.gsub(iType, "%)", "")
local itemName = args.item or "Unknown item"
if data.loot[iType] == nil then data.loot[iType] = 0 end
data.loot[iType] = tonumber(data.loot[iType]) + 1
if iType ~= "Normal" then blootBatchCount = blootBatchCount + 1
blootBatchTypes[iType] = (blootBatchTypes[iType] or 0) + 1
-- Only announce bloot qualities that are not on the discard list. -- Discarded qualities are still counted in reports/statistics. if not discardBlootTypes[iType] then message = "@W-@M-@W-@M-@W-@M> @YYou Crafted Bloot: @W" .. iType .. " @M<@W-@M-@W-@M-@W- @C(@W" .. itemName .. "@C)@w"
CallPlugin( "b555825a4a5700c35fa80780", "storeFromOutside", "" .. message, 1, true, true ) end
data.lastBonus = data.totalskins end
saveSkinnerData() end
-- Report skinning data function reportData(name, line, wildcards) normalizeSkinnerData()
local channel = wildcards.channel or ""
if channel == "" then ColourNote( skinnerColor, "", "[Skinner]: Usage: skinner report <channel>" ) return end
-- "note" is a special local MUSHclient output channel. local useNote = string.lower(channel) == "note"
local tStr = tag .. " " local totalBloot = 0 local blootReport = "" local sadReport = ""
tStr = tStr .. "@cTotal Skins: @w" .. commas(data.totalskins) .. "@c. "
local sinceBonus = data.totalskins - data.lastBonus
if sinceBonus == 1 then tStr = tStr .. "@cLast bonus: @w" .. commas(sinceBonus) .. " skin ago@c. " else tStr = tStr .. "@cLast bonus: @w" .. commas(sinceBonus) .. " skins ago@c. " end
tStr = tStr .. "@cLoot: @D[@W"
local tCount = 0
for k, v in spairs( data.loot, function(t,a,b) return t[a] > t[b] end ) do local percentage = 0
if data.totalskins > 0 then percentage = (v / data.totalskins) * 100 end
if tCount > 0 then blootReport = blootReport .. " " end
blootReport = blootReport .. k .. "@c: @G" .. commas(v) .. "@c(@C" .. string.format("%.4f%%", percentage) .. "@c)@W"
tCount = tCount + 1 totalBloot = totalBloot + v end
blootReport = blootReport .. "@D]@w"
local normalCount = data.totalskins - totalBloot local normalPercentage = 0
if data.totalskins > 0 then normalPercentage = (normalCount / data.totalskins) * 100 end
sadReport = "@WNormal: @G" .. commas(normalCount) .. "@c(@C" .. string.format("%.4f%%", normalPercentage) .. "@c) @W"
-- Build the complete report without a channel prefix. local report = tStr .. sadReport .. blootReport
if useNote then -- Note() does not understand Aardwolf @ color codes, -- so remove them before displaying locally. local noteReport = report:gsub("@[A-Za-z]", "")
Note(noteReport) else ColourNote( skinnerColor, "", "[Skinner]: Sending report to specified channel..." )
SendNoEcho(channel .. " " .. report) end end
-- Reset skinning data function resetData() ColourNote(skinnerColor,"","[Skinner]: Resetting Data")
data = { totalskins = 0, lastBonus = 0, loot = {} }
saveSkinnerData() end
-- Manually force both plugin-state and independent backup copies to disk. function manualBackup() saveSkinnerData()
local backupFile = getSkinnerBackupFile()
ColourNote( "lime", "", "[Skinner]: Lifetime report data backed up successfully." )
if backupFile then ColourNote( skinnerColor, "", "[Skinner]: Backup file: " .. backupFile ) end end
-- Restore data from the independent backup without altering the backup first. function manualRestore() local restored, restoreError = readSkinnerBackup()
if not restored then ColourNote( "red", "", "[Skinner]: Could not restore backup: " .. tostring(restoreError or "unknown error") ) return end
data = restored normalizeSkinnerData()
-- Rebuild the standard plugin-state copy from the backup. SetVariable("ks_data", serialize.save_simple(data)) SaveState()
ColourNote( "lime", "", "[Skinner]: Lifetime report data restored from backup." )
ColourNote( skinnerColor, "", "[Skinner]: Total Skins restored: " .. commas(data.totalskins) ) end
-- Helper function function spairs(t, order) -- collect the keys local keys = {} for k in pairs(t) do keys[#keys+1] = k end
-- if order function given, sort by it by passing the table and keys a, b, -- otherwise just sort the keys if order then table.sort(keys, function(a,b) return order(t, a, b) end) else table.sort(keys) end
-- return the iterator function local i = 0 return function() i = i + 1 if keys[i] then return keys[i], t[keys[i]] end end end
function checkItems() -- Gotta set the score compareSet()
wait.make (function() SendNoEcho("echo {kelinv}") SendNoEcho("inv") SendNoEcho("echo {/kelinv}") wait.time(1) end) end
--function checkitem(name,line,args) -- ColourNote("Green","",string.sub(line,9)) -- itemlist.index = --end
-- Set up compare function compareSet() -- Setting all stats to a score of "2" and HR/DR to a score of "1" SendNoEcho("compare set str 2") SendNoEcho("compare set con 2") SendNoEcho("compare set dex 2") SendNoEcho("compare set int 2") SendNoEcho("compare set wis 2") SendNoEcho("compare set lck 2") SendNoEcho("compare set hr 2") SendNoEcho("compare set dr 2") end
